questions_and_answers.question: What type of highway projects does Azores Infrastructure undertake?
questions_and_answers.answer: We execute regional & national highways, 4-lane and 6-lane expressways, road widening, bypasses, and structural pavement rehabilitation following IRC and MoRTH standards.

questions_and_answers.question: Does Azores construct 4-lane and 6-lane highways?
questions_and_answers.answer: Yes, we specialize in high-capacity 4-lane and 6-lane highway expansions, complete with grade-separated intersections and service roads.

questions_and_answers.question: What paving technologies do you use for highway construction?
questions_and_answers.answer: We deploy flexible asphalt paving (DBM, BC, SMA) and rigid concrete paving (PQC, DLC) using electronic sensor-equipped pavers.

questions_and_answers.question: Are your highway projects compliant with NHAI and MoRTH standards?
questions_and_answers.answer: Absolutly. As a Class 1A registered contractor, all highway works adhere strictly to NHAI, MoRTH, and IRC specifications.

questions_and_answers.question: How do you manage drainage in highway projects?
questions_and_answers.answer: We integrate side drains, catch pits, box culverts, and slope stabilization measures to ensure long-term structural durability.

questions_and_answers.question: Do you handle highway resurfacing and rehabilitation?
questions_and_answers.answer: Yes, we undertake major highway rehabilitation, asphalt overlaying, milling, and structural pavement strengthening.

questions_and_answers.question: What earthwork and site preparation capabilities do you have for roads?
questions_and_answers.answer: We handle bulk earthwork, embankment cutting and filling, subgrade stabilization, and soil compaction using heavy vibratory compactors.

questions_and_answers.question: Do you build toll plazas and highway rest areas?
questions_and_answers.answer: Yes, as part of turnkey highway projects we construct toll plazas, weigh stations, truck lay-bys, and highway amenities.

questions_and_answers.question: What machinery is used in your highway projects?
questions_and_answers.answer: Our fleet includes electronic sensor pavers, double-drum vibratory rollers, motor graders, WMM batching plants, and asphalt mixing units.

questions_and_answers.question: How do I submit a highway tender or project inquiry to Azores?
questions_and_answers.answer: You can submit tender documents or project inquiries via email at Azores.ranchi@gmail.com or call +91 7004709933.
